subject: being wrong
caption: Which one are you when you're wrong? Most people are a defender at work and a learner with strangers.

beats.text: When you're wrong, there are four reactions. Only one of them keeps your friends.
You argue the point until everyone gives up. Then you think about it all night.
You say oh, good point, and actually mean it. That's rarer than it sounds.
It was the instructions. It was the timing. It was never you.
You go quiet, agree in the moment, and quietly keep doing it your way.
Being wrong is free information. Most people pay for it with a fight.
Follow for the stuff nobody teaches you.
